reviews.title: Solid RAM at a good price
reviews.comment: I’m happy with this purchase since it works well for my scientific calculation purposes, requiring 40 ~ 70 GB of RAM daily. Also, 6000 MT/sec speed for a 1:1 ratio works stably under higher loads. Temperature was around 45 ~ 55 °C for the normal circumstances at a small form factor PC, so you may expect lower temps in general. After you install this RAM, you may need to clear the CMOS and turn the PC on to train your memory, or otherwise it will not work well. It took me 5 minutes for the memory training, but after that, this beefy 96 GB of RAM worked solid with EXPO settings without an issue. The voltage setting (1.4 V) for the EXPO may seem high compared to other 1.35 V RAM, but this memory is 96 GB and it is quite a common setting for higher capacity memory.

reviews.title: Stable, no OC needed, capacity is true
reviews.comment: Excellent RAM at a fantastic price.  Works perfectly well in my desktop paired with a MSI B650 Tomahawk and a Ryzen 7 9800X3D.  Perfectly stable at 6000/MTs.  Comparable to best price / per GB deals on the market when its on sale, I see no reason not to buy this kit.
reviews.author: Hinkydoo

reviews.title: 6000 MHz on Gigabyte X870E with 2 sticks. 4800 MHz with 4 sticks!
reviews.comment: Got two of these! Works great at 6000 MHz with just two sticks with the Gigabyte X870E AORUS ELITE WIFI7 motherboard. With 4 sticks, it runs stable at 4800 MHz with my 9950X3D. It SEEMED to run stable at 5600MHz (Windows posted and ran fine for a while) but did not survive the stress test on the memory. Still very happy with the purchase since it runs at 48000 MHz at 196 GB of RAM! P.S. With this much RAM, you can create even a virtual hard drive within the RAM and still have more than enough RAM for everything else.
